company.name: The Digital Hotelier
company.shortDescription: Hotels, Hotel apartments and Holiday Homes SaaS
company.description: The Digital Hotelier is a cutting-edge SaaS company providing innovative solutions to the hospitality industry. With their advanced platform, hotels can enable their guests to effortlessly order and book any service they desire with just a click of a button. The platform also offers a convenient multilingual interface for holiday homes and hotel apartment guests to order all their needs from a single, comprehensive platform, eliminating the need to download multiple apps. The Digital Hotelier sets itself apart from the competition by delivering exceptional service and providing a seamless experience for guests and hotel staff alike.

productsAndServices.description: A web-based platform enabling hotel guests to order services, book facilities, and communicate with staff via QR codes without app downloads.

productsAndServices.description: Integration of third-party service providers like taxi, car rental, pharmacy, and entertainment into the guest platform to expand service offerings and generate revenue.
productsAndServices.name: External Services Integration

productsAndServices.description: Support for up to seven native languages on the guest platform, enabling guests to interact in their preferred language without additional charges.
productsAndServices.name: Multi-language Native Translation Support

productsAndServices.description: A dashboard feature allowing hotels to create, manage, and translate up to 12 promotional banners, including clickable image and video banners.
productsAndServices.name: Promotional Banners and Marketing Management

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,000,000, or 60.61% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,550,000 to $10,093,496, a 2.22x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 39 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 46 (-11).
